about_short_description.short_description: zVendo is an e-commerce platform where you can build your online store and display your brand.

product.name: zVendo eCommerce Subscription Services
product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables businesses to create and manage online stores with web and mobile applications, supporting multi-language interfaces and various payment and shipping integrations.

product.name: zVendo Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app that allows merchants to manage their online store orders and operations on the go, available on Google Play and Apple App Store.

product.name: zVendo Point of Sale (POS) Software
product.description: A cash register software integrated with the zVendo platform to manage in-person sales alongside online transactions.

product.name: Shipping and Warehousing Integration Services
product.description: Services that integrate shipping methods and warehousing solutions with the zVendo platform to support order fulfillment and logistics.

product.name: Payment Integration Services
product.description: Integration of various payment methods including online payments, cash on delivery, and sector-based commission discounts within the zVendo platform.

product.name: Marketing Tools and Integrations
product.description: A set of tools integrated into the platform for marketing activities, including social login, Facebook Pixel, Google Analytics, promotions, and customer engagement features.
